fcl_lcl.title: FCL vs LCL on France ↔ China — Choose the right mode | MB Fret Services
fcl_lcl.desc: Volume thresholds (~13–15 m³), security, costs. Compare FCL and LCL on the France ↔ China corridor and optimise your budget.
intro: FCL (full container) maximises control and reduces handling; LCL (groupage) optimises budget for volumes below ~13–15 m³. The decision must consider volume, value, transit time and cargo sensitivity.

ul: Indicative thresholds: 20’ ≈ 33 m³, 40’ ≈ 67 m³, 40’HC ≈ 76 m³
Total delivered cost: compare FCL vs LCL (pre/post-carriage, THC, surcharges, insurance, customs)
Risk: LCL involves consolidation; prioritise export-grade packing and ad valorem insurance
Recurring programs: FCL as the primary mode; LCL for prototypes and small batches
Seasonal peaks (CNY, Q4): secure capacity early and anticipate cut-offs

faq.q: What is the threshold to switch from LCL to FCL?
faq.a: Around 13–15 m³ depending on ports and season. Also factor in value, risk and required lead times.
It includes consolidation/deconsolidation steps. Proper export packing and ad valorem insurance significantly reduce risk.

faq.q: Can we mix LCL and air freight?
faq.a: Yes, to meet a critical deadline. We design a multimodal scheme adapted to your constraints.

faq.q: Which FCL container types are available?
faq.a: 20’, 40’, 40’HC; Reefer/Open Top options after a feasibility study and depending on cargo type.

faq.q: How do I estimate my CBM?
faq.a: Length×Width×Height×Quantity / 1,000,000. Use our online CBM calculator.
